title: Payroll batch times out every Monday morning
description: Users report HTTP 504s and delayed salary payouts during the Monday payroll batch window. The portal is slow and worker jobs are timing out.
initial_mitigation: Stopped the non-critical batch workers and moved critical salary runs to a lower priority lane.
rca_reason: Repeated Monday morning degradation during the payroll batch.

title: Payment API intermittent failures
description: Customers experienced intermittent failures when attempting to complete card payments.
initial_mitigation: Payment API pods were restarted and traffic was partially redirected to secondary instances.
rca_reason: Recurring incident affecting a critical business service.

title: Card authorisation requests slow during retry bursts
description: Checkout requests intermittently returned server errors and some authorisations took longer than five seconds during an afternoon maintenance window.
symptoms: Payment request latency above five seconds
initial_mitigation: Restarted affected API pods and temporarily reduced retry concurrency.
rca_reason: Critical payment flow degradation during maintenance.

title: Payment authorisation latency increase after routine release
description: A subset of card payment requests became slow after a routine release, while health checks and non-payment endpoints remained available.
initial_mitigation: Disabled the newest payment worker pool and routed requests to the previous deployment.
rca_reason: Repeated latency regression following a deployment.

title: Checkout requests intermittently fail in the payment region
description: Customers in two regions saw sporadic checkout failures and delayed responses, while settlement processing continued normally.
initial_mitigation: Restarted the busiest API instances and limited concurrent retry requests.
rca_reason: Recurring payment instability requiring technical investigation.

title: Customer portal exceptions after regional failover
description: An unusual spike of portal errors happens after traffic shifts to a secondary region. The same feature works normally elsewhere.
initial_mitigation: Forced the region back to primary routing and cleared stale session locks.
rca_reason: One-off regional routing anomaly without strong historical support.

title: API gateway certificate check error on edge nodes
description: Customers encounter handshake errors when connecting through the API gateway. The issue is isolated to a subset of public edge nodes.
initial_mitigation: Rotated the wildcard certificate manually and restored edge service restart jobs.
rca_reason: A public certificate issue affecting the whole banking edge layer.

title: Settlement service deadlocks during event processing
description: Transactions stop being processed for several minutes while the settlement queue waits on a blocked partition leader.
initial_mitigation: Restarted the blocked consumer group and replayed the backlog from the last safe offset.
rca_reason: Repeated stuck queue processing in the settlement stream.

title: Billing report times out at month close
description: At the end of the month the billing pipeline stalls and invoice reports fail to complete within the normal SLA.
initial_mitigation: Reduced batch concurrency and postponed the non-critical report jobs until after close.
rca_reason: The issue repeats at the end of the month on a regular schedule.

title: Notification queue spikes during campaign launch
description: Notification delivery slows during a campaign push and the queue begins to back up with delayed messages.
initial_mitigation: Paused the non-essential campaign stream and cleaned disk usage on the broker nodes.
rca_reason: This follows the same queue pressure pattern seen during previous release bursts.

title: Auth service restarts during burst traffic
description: User authentication starts failing repeatedly under burst traffic as pods are restarted after memory pressure events.
initial_mitigation: Scaled the auth stack horizontally and reverted the memory-limited deployment.
rca_reason: Multiple pod kills are tied to the same deployment revision.

title: Reporting service intermittently fails DNS lookups
description: Reports intermittently fail to resolve upstream service names during bursts, causing transient task failures in the reporting pipeline.
initial_mitigation: Reduced batch concurrency and redirected traffic to a healthy DNS cluster.
rca_reason: Limited evidence and no clear historical match.

title: User profile serialisation errors after microservice update
description: Customer details intermittently fail to load after an application update, producing schema mismatch and serialization exceptions.
initial_mitigation: Rolled back the gateway compatibility patch and re-enabled the previous serializer configuration.
rca_reason: Failure aligns with a recent microservice contract change.

title: Gateway clients report handshake failures
description: External clients intermittently failed to establish secure sessions through the public gateway.
initial_mitigation: Routed traffic to healthy edge nodes.
rca_reason: Public gateway availability incident.

title: User profile fields fail to load intermittently
description: Some profile responses contained missing fields after an upstream service update.
initial_mitigation: Reverted the compatibility configuration.
rca_reason: Repeated contract compatibility symptoms.

title: Payroll batch delays employee portal requests
description: The scheduled payroll workload increased response times for employee portal requests during the morning run.
initial_mitigation: Paused non-critical batch workers.
rca_reason: Recurring batch window degradation.

title: Settlement events stop processing temporarily
description: Settlement messages accumulated while event processing became intermittently unavailable.
initial_mitigation: Restarted the affected consumer group.
rca_reason: Event processing interruption.

title: Month-end invoice report processing slows
description: Invoice aggregation exceeded its normal completion window during month-end processing.
initial_mitigation: Reduced report concurrency.
rca_reason: Repeated month-end processing delay.

title: Authentication pods restart during demand spike
description: Authentication requests failed intermittently while several application pods restarted under load.
initial_mitigation: Scaled the authentication deployment.
rca_reason: Repeated authentication availability issue.

title: Notification delivery backlog grows during campaign
description: A campaign generated delayed notification delivery and increasing broker queue depth.
initial_mitigation: Paused the campaign stream and cleared broker disk space.
rca_reason: Repeated message broker capacity symptoms.
